## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `googleapis-gcalendar-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a Google cloud platform project

1. <!-- manual: Go to the [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/). -->
2. Select the project drop-down at the top of the page and select **New Project**.
3. <!-- manual: Enter a Project Name (e.g., Ballerina Calendar Integration) and click Create. -->
4. Once created, select the new project from the drop-down to make it the active project.

## Step 3: Enable the Google calendar API

1. <!-- manual: In the Google Cloud Console, open the left navigation menu and go to APIs & Services › Library. -->
2. Search for `Google Calendar API`.
3. Select **Google Calendar API** result.
4. Select **Enable**.

## Step 4: Configure the OAuth consent screen

1. <!-- manual: In the left navigation menu, go to APIs & Services › OAuth consent screen. -->
2. Select **External** as the user type (or **Internal** if your account is a Google Workspace account).
3. Select **Create**.
4. <!-- manual: Fill in the required fields: -->
5. <!-- manual: App name: Enter a name (e.g., Ballerina Calendar App). -->
6. <!-- manual: User support email: Select your email address. -->
7. <!-- manual: Developer contact information: Enter your email address. -->
8. Select **Save and Continue** through the Scopes and Test Users screens.
9. On the Summary screen, select **Back to Dashboard**.

## Step 5: Create OAuth 2.0 client ID credentials

1. <!-- manual: In the left navigation menu, go to APIs & Services › Credentials. -->
2. Select **+ Create Credentials** and select **OAuth client ID**.
3. Under **Application type**, select **Web application**.
4. <!-- manual: Enter a name (e.g., Ballerina Calendar Client). -->
5. <!-- manual: Under Authorized redirect URIs, click + Add URI and add: -->
6. Select **Create**.
7. <!-- note: A dialog displays your **Client ID** and **Client Secret**; copy and save both values securely. -->

## Step 6: Obtain a refresh token via OAuth 2.0 playground

1. <!-- manual: Go to the [OAuth 2.0 Playground](https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground). -->
2. <!-- manual: Click the settings icon (gear icon) in the top-right corner. -->
3. Check **Use your own OAuth credentials** and enter your **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.
4. <!-- manual: Close the settings panel. -->
5. <!-- manual: In the left panel under Step 1, find and select the following scope: -->
6. Select **Authorize APIs** and sign in with your Google account when prompted.
7. After authorization, click **Exchange authorization code for tokens** in **Step 2**.
8. <!-- manual: Copy the Refresh token value from the response. -->
